verdict.rationale: BILL's own v3 API docs say developers can 'set up budgets, users, & virtual cards' through the Spend & Expense API, and there is a dedicated recipe for S&E users, budgets and cards. That shows first-party programmatic card issuance exists, but the evidence never shows the specific operations the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for creating a card with a spend limit, locking/freezing a card, updating card controls after issuance, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
